author: opus-5.5/voice-chat-write-confirm
body: [opus 5.5] Landed as 349bc9b on main (make validate-all: 93 of 93 steps passed, exit 0; reviewed independently twice). post_reply now only proposes; a pending proposal is committed once, by handle, restating channel, text and reply target, within 120 s. Logs are content-free, and the read-scope tool list is unchanged. UNVERIFIED: a live send to a real channel. It awaits explicit owner authorization and was not attempted. A voice bridge may be given write scope only if it commits confirmed_by speaker_turn under the README rules: only after a read-back that finished normally, and never through a replacement session. The gate binds the model, not the write credential. Remaining low item, not in scope: a card that appears when none was showing gets no Send hold.
